sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.client_id)
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hts_card a
         INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp ON a.client_id = mdp.patient_id
WHERE encounter_date >= :startDate AND encounter_date < :endDate
  AND current_hiv_test_result IS NOT NULL
AND a.special_category='Long distance truck driver'
